for_you.ask: 🔁 Decide: the accountant's advice, five agents to Sonnet, one at a time
for_you.detail: From the ledgers only (27 lines, 9 agents, each before its review): dashboard 3.0M tokens a wake (312K without cache reads), passed 5 of 5; watcher 5.5M (368K), 3 of 3; dev 6.6M (577K), 2 of 2; automation 3.6M (216K), 2 of 2; crm 4.1M (129K), 6 of 6. Cache reads are about 90 to 97% of their tokens and cost the same on both models ($0.20 per million); Sonnet 5.5 halves the rest ($2 / $10 per million against Opus 5.5's $4 / $20), so a routine wake costs roughly a third less. Opus stays for the conductor (Dinis), the helper (your word), the designer and vault. You change the model in each agent's session; the accountant changes nothing.
options: yes, one at a time, the dashboard first
for_you.recommend: Yes, the dashboard first: the most routine work and five passes out of five; the accountant watches its next three wakes before the next agent moves.
